name: Yamdu
description:
Yamdu is the production management platform for film, TV and commercial productions. Teams use it to break down scripts, plan shooting schedules, build call sheets, manage cast and crew, and keep budgets and time cards in one place.

The Yamdu connector gives your AI assistant read-only access to the productions you work on. Sign in with your Yamdu account and ask questions in plain language - the assistant looks up the answer in your live project data and links back to the relevant page in Yamdu.

What you can ask about
- Projects, creative works and the people and companies involved
- Script breakdown: scenes, characters, sets, wardrobe, props, effects, special actions and audio
- Shooting schedules, shooting days and production calendars
- Call sheets with call times, locations and notes
- Crew list, cast and production locations
- Budget scenarios and their totals
- Time cards, aggregated totals and labor agreements

Typical questions
- "Which scenes with Anna are still unscheduled?"
- "Summarize tomorrow's call sheet and list the crew call times."
- "How does the current budget scenario compare to the approved one?"
- "Which locations do we shoot at next week, and what are their addresses?"

Access and permissions
The connector never writes to Yamdu and only reads what you are allowed to see in the app. Your project roles and department permissions apply exactly as they do in Yamdu, and sensitive personal data such as contact details is only returned when your company allows it. A company administrator must enable the MCP Server in the company settings before members can connect. Access can be limited to selected projects and data areas and can be revoked at any time.

Requirements
- A Yamdu account
- A company plan that includes the MCP Server (AI Connections) feature
- MCP access enabled by your company administrator

Yamdu is developed and operated in Germany. All data is hosted in the EU.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Yamdu to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yamdu to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.yamdu.com/ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yamdu MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yamdu lists 30 MCP tools, including actorsOfTheCompany, aggregatedTimeCardTotalsOfAProject, allBudgetScenariosOfAProject, allCallSheetsOfAProject, allProductionCalendarsOfAProject, allShootingSchedulesOfAProject, charactersOfAProject, creativeWorksOfTheCompany, crewListOfAProject, crossEntitySearchOverTheScriptBreakdownOfAProject, effectsOfAProject, and laborAgreementsOfAProject.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yamdu?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Yamdu in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Yamdu requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yamdu is developed by Yamdu. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
